description: This file defines the MacroNode class within the Twig templating engine, representing a macro node in the template syntax tree. It includes constructor logic for argument handling and a compile method to generate PHP code for macro functions.

classes.name: MacroNode
classes.description: Represents a macro node in Twig's template syntax tree, enabling macro definition with argument validation and code compilation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a MacroNode, handling deprecation warnings for improper argument types, and validating that 'varargs' is not used as an argument name.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code that implements the macro by defining a method with arguments, context management, and call to the macro body.
